summary: Worker paginates by fetching its own public /sync route with fan-out.

expected_findings.explanation: Each /sync request calls the supplier API, writes every item to KV, then fetches its own public origin once per next cursor via waitUntil. The chain is cut at 16 Worker-to-Worker calls (error 1019) but fan-out multiplies, so one unauthenticated request can cause up to branching^16 invocations, KV writes and supplier API calls. The supplier controls the branching factor.
